installedImprovementsDescription: The last change included in this exact image. This is neither the list of available updates nor the complete release history.
installedImprovementsLink: View the installed revision and its history
installedChangesUnavailable: The installed revision summary could not be retrieved. Its history is still available through the link below.
componentPlatformUnknown: The image for this server’s platform could not be verified. Check the Manager version and filtered access to registry metadata. A Docker catalog difference alone is never offered as an update.
managerBackupPreferenceUnsaved: Changed choice, not saved for future visits.
managerBackupPreferenceHelp: Save this choice for future visits to this installation. Development and production each have their own setting. Saving does not start an update; each operation still requires confirmation.
managerBackupPreferenceReadError: The saved choice could not be read. Retry before preparing an update.
managerBackupPreferenceSaveError: The choice could not be saved. Your selection is retained; try saving again.
managerFastSelectedBackupHelp: Reuse local images verified by digest. This setting does not change the backup choice above or health checks.
managerBackupSelectionHelp: Choose a full backup, minimal backup or no backup before each update. Save the choice under Update for this installation; every operation still requires confirmation.
managerFullBackupHelp: Copy all persistent data for this environment: database, configuration, secrets, conversation histories, project files, deliverables, versions, drafts, logs and caches. External /appdata mounts require a separate backup.
managerMinimalBackupHelp: Copy the entire SQLite database and configuration: Codex settings, authentication, global instructions, model catalog, Git configuration, SSH and stack secrets. No project files, deliverable documents/versions or on-disk Codex histories are copied. Project metadata and messages already stored in the database remain included.
managerNoBackupHelp: No data will be backed up. Health checks remain enabled. If the update fails, only images will be restored: data and migrations will not be undone and may be incompatible with the previous version.
managerMinimalUpdateWarning: The entire database and configuration will be backed up after services stop. On failure, only these data and images will be restored. Project files, documents, versions and on-disk Codex histories remain current; the restored database may no longer match those files. Replaced data is kept in quarantine.
managerMinimalRollbackWarning: Restore previous images, database and configuration only? Project files, documents, versions and on-disk Codex histories remain unchanged and may no longer match the restored database. Replaced data is kept in quarantine.
updateMinimalBackupPathUnsupported: Minimal backup requires the database and configuration to be under /home/codex, without ambiguous paths.
updateMinimalDatabaseMissing: The SQLite database was not found. Minimal backup is blocked.
updateUnsafePath: A backup or recovery path is missing, ambiguous or contains a disallowed symbolic link.
managerDevelopmentNoBackup: Dev: no data backup before updating. Rollback restores images only; data and any migrations are not undone. Existing backups are not deleted.
managerProductionEssentialBackup: Production: back up the database, conversations, documents and versions, unpublished Git work, configuration and secrets. Identifiable logs, caches and dependencies are excluded. Ambiguous build/dist directories are retained.
managerLegacyFullBackup: This older operation used a full backup. Recovery keeps its original scope.
managerFastDevNoBackupHelp: Reuse only local images verified by digest. Both Dev modes keep health checks but create no data backup.
managerUpdateNoBackupWarning: Services will be unavailable during replacement and health checks. No data will be backed up in Dev. On failure, only the previous images will be restored: migrations and changed data cannot be restored automatically.
managerUpdateEssentialWarning: Services will be unavailable during essential-data backup and health checks. On failure, previous images and these data will be restored. Excluded logs, caches and dependencies will not be restored and may need regeneration. External /appdata files require a separate backup.
managerRollbackImagesOnlyWarning: Restore previous images without restoring data? No backup was created for this operation. Data and migrations will remain in their current state and may be incompatible with the previous version.
updateBackupPolicyInvalid: The backup policy is unknown or inconsistent. Updates and recovery are not allowed.
mergeronManagerTimeout: The Manager did not respond in time. Check the operation status before retrying: it may have started.
mergeronManagerInvalidResponse: The Manager response is incomplete or invalid. Refresh its status before retrying.
managerUpdateSuperseded: This is no longer the current operation
managerUpdateSupersededHelp: Another operation has finished and the Manager is idle. This retained journal is incomplete: close this window, then open the latest progress view to inspect the current result.
componentUpdatesUnavailable: Discovery unavailable. The Manager must support image discovery.
componentUpdatesUnknown: Unknown: source, installed digest or registry unavailable. No automatic update offered.
componentUpdatesCurrent: This container is current on its channel.
componentUpdatesNotesHelp: Check the improvements published by the vendor. The registry does not provide a reliable summary of differences between these two images.
managerRetentionHelp: Default: 10. From 1 to 1,000 backups. After each successful update, the oldest backups beyond this limit are permanently deleted. Saving does not delete anything immediately; protected backups and quarantine data are preserved.
managerRetentionError: Could not read or save the backup limit.
updateFastDevelopmentOnly: Fast updates require an isolated development stack.
managerFastDevUpdateHelp: Bounded parallel copying and reuse of local images identified by digest. Full backups, health checks and data restoration remain enabled. Disable to use the standard procedure.
managerBackupsHelp: Backups accumulate after updates. Deleting a backup is permanent and disables rollback using that copy. Current project data and quarantined files are not deleted.
managerBackupsUpgradeRequired: Update Mergeron Manager to enable backup management.
managerBackupIncomplete: Incomplete or previously interrupted deletion: not available for rollback.
managerBackupOperationProtected: Protected while an operation or recovery is in progress.
managerBackupMetadataProtected: Protected: the backup metadata could not be verified.
managerBackupDeleteConfirm: Permanently delete the backup from {{date}}? The current data will be kept, but rollback using this backup will no longer be possible.
managerBackupDeleteFailed: Could not delete this backup. Refresh the list before retrying.
managerUpdateRequestFailed: Unable to confirm the update request.
managerUpdateStartUnconfirmed: The operation has not yet been confirmed as started
managerUpdateProgressDescription: Steps and the journal refresh automatically. This window stays open during the operation.
managerUpdateStageProgress: Progress shows stages, not an estimate of time remaining. The journal may catch up after services restart.
managerUpdateReconnecting: The server is temporarily unavailable during restart. The last received step stays visible without assuming further progress. Reconnecting automatically: monitoring will resume once the server is available and your identity has been verified.
managerUpdateRequestUncertain: Checking the current state automatically. Do not restart the operation without reviewing the journal.
managerInstallationAlreadyManaged: This installation is already managed by Mergeron Manager. No additional adoption is needed.
managerAutomaticDetection: Automatically checks for new images on the current channel (edge or latest) every five minutes. Updates are never installed without confirmation.
managerNewImageAvailable: A new Mergeron image is available.
managerImageChangesDescription: Changes between the installed and proposed images, from release notes or GitHub commits.
managerChangesUnavailable: A new image was detected, but its descriptions are unavailable. Review the comparison link before confirming.
managerChangesTruncated: The list is limited to 100 commits. Use the comparison link to view all changes.
managerUpdateSeparateFromSettings: This action checks prerequisites, then asks for confirmation before applying the selected backup scope, installing and restarting services. It is separate from saving settings.
managerInfrastructureDescription: Review Mergeron Manager, service health and protected persistent storage.
managerUpdateSafetyDescription: The Manager saves the stopped application state, checks service health and restores the previous version if an update fails.
managerUpdateRollingBack: Returning to the previous version using the operation’s backup policy
managerUpdateRecoveryRequired: Recovery requires attention; new operations are blocked
managerUpdateBackupRetained: The backup is retained. Data written by the failed version is kept separately, not deleted.
managerUpdateBlocked: The plan is blocked by safety checks.
managerRollbackDataWarning: This stops the services and restores the previous version AND the saved application data. More recent data is kept separately. External /appdata files are never restored or deleted.
managerUpdateDowntimeWarning: The services will be unavailable while the backup and health checks run. The Manager stays available through its local socket. If checks fail, the saved version and application data will be restored. External /appdata files are outside the backup scope.
managerOperationInProgress: Another Manager operation is already in progress.
updateAdoptionDrift: The installation no longer matches its adopted state.
updateBlocked: The update is blocked by safety checks.
updateCandidateIdentityConflict: A replacement container changed unexpectedly. Recovery is paused to protect your data.
updateDockerOrFilesystemFailure: A Docker or storage operation failed. Check the Manager and Docker logs.
updateHealthCheckFailed: A service failed its health check.
updateHealthCheckTimeout: A service did not become healthy within the allowed time.
updateImageDigestUnavailable: An immutable published image digest is required.
updateImageNotAllowed: This image is not from an authorized repository.
updateInsufficientBackupSpace: There is not enough storage space for a safe backup.
updateBackupArchiveInvalid: The compressed backup or its metadata is invalid. No live data was restored.
updateBackupArchiveCorrupt: The compressed backup failed its integrity check. No live data was restored.
updateBackupArchiveWriteFailed: Writing the compressed backup failed. The update was not applied.
updateBackupSourceChanged: Files changed while the backup was being created. The update was not applied.
updateJournalInvalid: The recovery journal does not match this stack.
updateOriginalIdentityConflict: An original container changed unexpectedly. Recovery is paused.
updatePlanChanged: The installation changed. Generate a new update plan.
updateRecoveryRequired: Complete recovery before starting another update.
updateRollbackUnavailable: Rollback is not available for this operation.
updateUnsupportedPersistentFile: The backup contains an unsupported special file. No update was applied.
